draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Haripad! It has the highest number of temples of any town in Kerala, which is why people call it Kshetranagari, the Town of Temples.
draft.hungryLine: I don't have named food spots for Haripad, so ask a local where they go for a proper Kerala meal.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Mannarasala Temple, devoted to the serpent gods, is about a 20 min walk, and Haripad Temple is the other big one in town.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Take the slow 20 min stroll out to Mannarasala Temple and let the temple calm do its thing.
moodReplies.surprise-me: The town used to be called Arippatt, and the name Haripad only came into prominence in the 20th century.

spots.name: Mannarasala Temple
spots.detail: 20 min walk · A Hindu temple for the worship of serpent gods

legends.title: Land of snake boats
legends.body: Haripad is known as the land of snake boats, and as a land of art, music, dance and drama. It's a real source of local pride.

tips.title: Plan a temple trail.
tips.body: Haripad Temple and Mannarasala Temple are the chief ones in this Town of Temples, so give yourself time for both.

tips.title: Dress modestly at temples.
tips.body: These are working Hindu temples, so cover shoulders and knees and follow local customs.

story.title: Arippatt
story.body: The town was once known as Arippatt. Some scholars say the name means a place near water.

story.title: A new name
story.body: The name Haripad only came into prominence in the 20th century.

story.title: Hub of Onattukara
story.body: Haripad is the main economic and cultural hub of the Onattukara region, and one of Kerala's largest thermal power plants, the NTPC-run Rajiv Gandhi Combined Cycle Power Plant, is here.
